stories.title: Heights Finance Data Breach Impacts at Least 1.2 Million Individuals
stories.description: Hackers stole names, addresses, phone numbers, Social Security numbers, and financial information from a third-party platform.

stories.title: SafePal Hardware Wallet Maker Says Flaw Exposed Data of Nearly 40,000 Customers
stories.description: SafePal says an order-tracking flaw exposed personal and shipping data for 39,798 customers, but not wallet credentials or financial data.

stories.title: GitLab Patches Critical Code Injection Vulnerability
stories.description: The security defect allows unauthenticated attackers to modify or delete user data and public projects.

stories.title: Critical WordPress Plugin Vulnerability Exposes 600,000 Sites to File Upload Attacks
stories.description: A critical Forminator flaw lets unauthenticated attackers upload malicious PHP files, potentially taking full control of vulnerable WordPress sites.

stories.title: VMware vCenter Attackers Drop JSP Webshell Disguised as Performance Update
stories.description: Attackers exploit VMware vCenter CVE-2026-59310 for root access, persistence, ESXi control, and ransomware deployment.

stories.title: Critical GitLab GraphQL Vulnerability Allow Attackers to Delete Public Projects
stories.description: GitLab patched a critical GraphQL flaw allowing unauthenticated attackers to modify or delete public projects and user data.

stories.title: Windows 11 File Explorer Gets Faster, Customizable Right-Click Menu With App Extension Controls
stories.description: Microsoft redesigned Windows 11 File Explorer’s context menu for faster right-clicks, less clutter, and improved controls.

stories.title: Dozens of WebKit Vulnerabilities Patched With Fresh macOS, iOS Security Updates
stories.description: The bugs could be exploited to crash Safari, corrupt memory, leak sensitive data, escape the sandbox, and exfiltrate data.

stories.title: CISA Flags Actively Exploited Ray Flaw That Can Trigger Browser-Based RCE
stories.description: CISA adds actively exploited Ray flaw CVE-2025-62593 to KEV; DNS rebinding can trigger browser-based RCE on developer systems.
